question: What complete division of octads does the seeker wish to understand?
premises: The subject is the division of eight octads.
The seeker desires full knowledge of this division.
The knowledge is sought in an exhaustive manner.
inference: The seeker wishes to know fully and exhaustively the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may indicate endless extent or thoroughness
plain_english: And I wish to know fully and completely the division of the eight octads.
